own_solution.law: Relativistic cyclotron frequency f = eB/(2 pi gamma m), gamma = 1 + T/(m c^2)
assumptions: uniform constant B, no E field

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: T13DE and T30C5 say 'a little' instead of 75 MeV, so they are not same-number variants of TE2A4/T836B; acceptable only if intended as non-numeric controls.

notes: Base: gamma = 1 + 100/938.63 = 1.10654; eB/(2 pi m) = 1.8288e7 Hz; f = 1.6527e7 Hz. With 175 MeV: gamma = 1.18644, f = 1.5414e7 Hz. T836B refers to an earlier injection only, so it does not affect the current orbit.
